notes: Required: idea, code, substantive results, paper (PDF full; TeX/markdown/JSON draft half).
Stub/seed metrics (e.g. dataset_candidate/metrics.json) do not satisfy results.
Framework noise (.deepscientist_npm, skills/templates, runtime) is excluded from code/results/paper.
Manifest status is informational; disk presence is authoritative.

novelty.justification: The artifact contains no core method, e.g., 'all three perspectives is missing or blank' and 'Please re-paste or upload the hypotheses', so there is no idea to compare against the Solution Space.
novelty.rubric: Existing: the idea's core method is already clearly present or solved in the Solution Space; only tiny parameter / test-case changes.
novelty.differentiation: No research method or direction is proposed; the artifact only states that hypotheses cannot be synthesized because source content is missing.

feasibility.justification: No plan, tooling, or evaluation is specified. The text only says 'I can’t synthesize the hypotheses because the content for all three perspectives is missing or blank', so as written it is not executable research.
feasibility.rubric: Theoretically infeasible / compute catastrophe: NP-hard-scale computation, must dynamically reproduce extremely complex system-level vulnerability environments, or depends on unavailable closed-source model internal weights; not doable by a single person.

clarity.justification: The artifact lacks a defined problem or solution; it states 'I don’t want to invent hypotheses' and asks for missing inputs, leaving only a meta-request rather than a research idea.
clarity.rubric: Vague concept: full of empty buzzwords; problem undefined; method only gives a high-level direction with little substance.

notes: Scores the intermediate idea artifact (not the final paper).
Dimensions: novelty, feasibility, clarity (each 1-5). Excitement removed.
Novelty is scored against a Solution Space built from mineru REFERENCES titles (+ related_work.json abstracts when matched).
idea_generation.summary: The submitted idea artifact is incomplete: it explicitly says hypothesis content from all three perspectives is missing and asks for it to be re-pasted. No research question, method, experiment plan, or evaluation criteria are proposed. Consequently, novelty, feasibility, and clarity cannot be meaningfully assessed, and the artifact does not constitute a scoreable research idea.
strengths: Transparently avoids fabricating hypotheses from absent source content.
Clearly identifies that required inputs are missing.
weaknesses: Contains no actual research hypothesis or method.
Provides no experimental design or evaluation plan.
Cannot be compared to prior work in the Solution Space because no technical core is present.

notes: Stanford Agentic Reviewer (paperreview.ai): manual download to artifacts/peer_review/stanford_apr.md, or pass --auto-paperreview.
Dimensions: soundness, significance, novelty, presentation, credibility (each 1-5).
peer_review.hint: Optional external review (Stanford APR). Upload paper/main.pdf to https://paperreview.ai/ , save review to ~/ai_scientist_inputs/ICSE-2025-002_evaluating_assisting_exploration_strateg/workspace/researchclaw_2026-08-31_11-28-59/artifacts/peer_review/stanford_apr.md

selection.note: mineru key is unreliable; blocks are selected by title/body/inheritance. rescued_from_other counts sections labeled other but treated as typed roles.

experiment_success.note: success=true requires substantive results (framework-aware path) with >=3 numeric leaves. Supports metrics.json, results.json, experiment_results.txt, etc. Manifest returncode/benchmark_complete are soft warnings only.

idea_code_consistency.label: severe_mismatch
idea_code_consistency.justification: The research idea contains no substantive hypotheses, predictions, failure conditions, or evaluation protocol because the source perspectives are missing. The experiment code is a generic logistic regression training/evaluation pipeline that does not instantiate any stated hypothesis, method, or evaluation plan.
matched_elements: Presence of an experiment pipeline (data, model, train, evaluate)
Logistic regression as a possible baseline method
missing_or_divergent_elements: Stated hypotheses from innovator, pragmatist, and contrarian perspectives
Research method tied to a specific problem
Baselines or comparisons required by the idea
idea_code_consistency.rubric: Severe mismatch: code implements a different problem/method than the idea, or is unrelated boilerplate.

setup_coverage.note: Coverage is name/alias matching against task.md Datasets/Baselines/Metrics. weak_protocol flags large reductions in trials/timeout vs Constraints. Synthetic corpora are not penalized when the task itself requires synthesis.

components.ablation_evidence: Single pipeline with no comparison variants; removing the split is not a meaningful ablation here.
components.significance_evidence: Single-run pilot; no repeated trials or performance metrics reported.

components.ablation_evidence: Only model shown; no removable method components or alternative model variants are specified.
components.significance_evidence: No statistical comparison planned or possible with the available evidence.

components.name: Training procedure
components.ablation_evidence: Boilerplate training loop; no alternative training strategies or ablations specified.
components.significance_evidence: Descriptive single-run training; formal significance testing is not standard.

components.name: Evaluation instrumentation
components.ablation_evidence: Evaluation saves metrics only; there is no comparison or removable instrumentation component to ablate.
components.significance_evidence: No metrics are present in the provided evidence, consistent with a pilot or incomplete run.

ablation_significance.summary: The available evidence describes a minimal single-model logistic regression pilot with missing hypotheses and no final metrics. No ablation or statistical testing is expected for this study type, so the pipeline is not assessed as deficient on those grounds.

coverage.note: Primary metric is recall against the original paper bibliography (titles from mineru_sections.json REFERENCES; related_work.json used only to enrich DOI/year or as fallback if mineru titles are empty). Denominator = |original paper references|. Precision is secondary (agent may cite valid extra papers).
